decisions: Technique/image preset titles; artist names are references, not imitation claims.
Research scopes works and periods, career evolution, persistent versus period traits, temporal movement, distinguishing vocabulary, and caricatures to avoid.
Exactly three independent reports plus a parent synthesis are required before activation.
Preset apply preserves tonic, tempo, devices, routing, sound, master level, mute/solo, plugins, and transport state.
Temporal behavior uses reusable Companion Lanes; stateless pitch mapping uses shared harmony strategies.
Stop after the first 12 for user testing.
